entries.en: Dammit... I wanna go home...
I don't wanna go to school...[n]This sucks...
I'm so tired every day...
I don't want to go to work...
Are there any[n]breaks coming up?
I heard there's a forum[n]about the Phantom Thieves.
Oh, I've seen him on TV!
He's famous, but he still rides[n]the train like everyone else...
Hey, isn't that[n]that detective?
The Phantom Thieves[n]are kinda cool, huh?
I heard they caught[n]some criminal.
People are saying it was[n]foretold by a calling card...
Oh, I know about that![n]I saw them in Shibuya!
That Phantom Thieves[n]forum is super active.
There's a forum!? What's[n]it called? I wanna see!

Having your money stolen[n]sounds terrifying...
It's unsettling not knowing[n]what they're going to do to us.

I really wish they'd[n]stop that...
At this rate they're gonna[n]end up attacking us...

I really wish they[n]wouldn't do this...

Did the Phantom Thieves[n]just decide to ignore it?

Stocks have been[n]falling ever since.
Who's going to take[n]responsibility for this?

I'm disappointed. What kind[n]of heroes are they?
Just get a move on and send[n]a calling card already.
I wonder what kind of[n]people the culprits are...
Probably some idiots with[n]a misguided sense of justice.
Look, can they just arrest[n]those guys already?
Special Investigations[n]is on it. I'm sure they'll[n]be caught soon.
What kind of people [n]are they? I wanna see [n]what they look like.
